beats.say: Nobody tells you this: seventy-three crore of Kalyan Jewellers' new profit came from something you can never wear.
lines: Not all of it is jewellery

beats.say: The headline first. July to September, Kalyan made four hundred and twenty-seven crore in profit. Up sixty-four percent.
But sales? Up thirty-one percent. So where did the extra profit come from?
lines: Profit grew twice as fast. Why?

beats.say: Kalyan sold a piece of land in Coimbatore. A one-time gain of seventy-three crore.
Take that out, and profit before tax grew thirty-nine percent. Not sixty.
lines: ₹487 cr vs ₹350 cr a year ago

beats.say: Still a strong quarter. But of every hundred rupees you spend there, Kalyan keeps about four. Follow for a daily breakdown.
lines: kept as profit from every ₹100 of sales
